title: Qronos Architecture Ratchet Allowlist
description: Baseline exception list for Qronos-owned domain architecture boundaries and state ratchets. Upstream-owned shared opencode files are exempt to prevent upstream merge conflicts. As Qronos legacy sites are refactored into clean Effect layers, decrement counts or remove entries to lock in progress.

qronos-instance-state-singletons.description: Legacy InstanceState.make usages in Qronos-owned code (packages/cli/src/qronos/**, packages/cli/src/qronos-*/**). Target: encapsulate in scoped Effect Services in packages/core.

packages/cli/src/qronos/session/control..reason: SessionPrompt-owned pause gates must remain isolated by directory and session in the shared backend

packages/cli/src/qronos/session/goal/run.reason: SessionPrompt-owned goal worker scopes must remain isolated by directory in the shared backend and close on instance disposal

qronos-database-constructors.description: Direct new Database() / new DatabaseSync() instantiations in Qronos-owned code. Target: all persistence routes through core Database.Service.

qronos-tool-process-env.description: Direct process.env reads in Qronos-owned tools. Target: pass configuration explicitly via Tool.Context or Env.Service.
